about:
Production Assembly was established in 2002 in Hildale, Utah. The company operates a facility centrally located to serve the Western United States. No founder names or ownership structure are disclosed in the available information.

The company designs and builds custom factory automation equipment, ranging from small labor‑saving fixtures to entire manufacturing cells and processing lines. Its services include advanced CAD modeling using 3D solid‑modeling software, in‑house controls and integration covering simple relay logic through fully integrated motion‑capable platforms, custom machining and fabrication with a steel fab shop and CAD/CAM milling capabilities, and programming services for process control, operator interfaces, and PC‑based data‑centric applications developed in VisualStudio.net. Many custom components are manufactured in‑house and locally to maintain control of project schedules.

The input does not specify particular industries or named customers; the company positions itself as serving automation needs across the Western United States.

Production Assembly emphasizes solving complex and unique automation problems. It leverages an extensive supply chain for fast component procurement and maintains schedule control by producing many custom components internally. Controls systems are fully documented with wiring schematics and matching conductor identification on every termination, and programming and integration are performed on site for turnkey delivery.
